attributes.body_ja:
「を問（と）わず」は特殊（とくしゅ）な活用（かつよう）を持（も）つ五段動詞（ごだんどうし）「問（と）う」（意味（いみ）：わからないことを聞（き）く）と文語（ぶんご）助動詞（じょどうし）「ず」（意味（いみ）：ない）を組（く）み合（あ）わせた文型（ぶんけい）です。これは本来（ほんらい）の意味（いみ）の「わからないことを聞（き）かずに」から転（てん）じて、「(A) に関係（かんけい）なく(B)」や「(A) を問題（もんだい）にしないで (B)」のような意味（いみ）の硬（かた）い表現（ひょうげん）として使（つか）われます。

ほとんどの場合（ばあい）、この表現（ひょうげん）は名詞（めいし）の後（あと）に置（お）かれますが、形容詞（けいようし）と結（むす）びついた「か」や「かどうか」の後（あと）に置（お）かれることもあります。「を」は「問（と）われない」対象（たいしょう）、つまり「問題（もんだい）にされないもの」を示（しめ）します。

「を問（と）わず」の代（か）わりに「は問（と）わず」と言（い）われることもあります。これにより対比（たいひ）のニュアンスが強調（きょうちょう）され、表現（ひょうげん）全体（ぜんたい）がやや強（つよ）くなります。

注意点（ちゅういてん）

「を問（と）わず」は文脈（ぶんみゃく）によって、特（とく）に (A) が範囲（はんい）や条件（じょうけん）を示（しめ）す場合（ばあい）に「(A) がどのようであっても (B)」のようなニュアンスに近（ちか）づくことがあります。以下（いか）、「を問（と）わず」と「に関（かか）わらず」の違（ちが）いを見（み）てみましょう。
attributes.body:
を問（と）わず is a pattern which makes use of the special-class う-Verb 問（と）う 'to inquire' and the literary auxiliary verb ず, which connects with verbs in the same way, and carries the same meaning as ない. While the literal meaning of this grammar structure is 'without questioning (A), (B)', it is used more as a formal way to express 'regardless of (A), (B)', 'whether (A) or not, (B)', or 'with or without (A)', (B)'.

This structure is seen almost exclusively after nouns, but can also follow structures like か, or かどうか that are modifying adjectives. を will mark the 'question' which is 'not being asked'.

Occasionally, は will replace を at the beginning of 問わず. This puts further emphasis on contrast, and slightly strengthens the phrase overall.

Caution

Although を問（と）わず may be thought of as similar to 'regardless', there are actually situations where the nuance is closer to 'in any case for (A), (B)'. This is particularly true when (A) is being expressed as a scope. Let's compare を問（と）わず to に関（かか）わらず to see the difference.

attributes.description: Difference between にかかわらず and を問わず

attributes.body: Both mean regardless of, but differ slightly in register. にかかわらず is more formal or literary, often used even with negative implications, as in 年齢にかかわらず (Regardless of age). を問わず is more common in daily usage, treating conditions equally without preference, as in 学歴を問わず (Regardless of academic background).

attributes.body: Both can mean regardless of, but are used differently. にもかかわらず expresses a surprising or unexpected result in spite of circumstances, as in 年齢にもかかわらず元気だ (In spite of his age, he is energetic). を問わず applies more broadly and neutrally, indicating that something holds true in all cases, as in 性別を問わず参加できる (Participation is open regardless of gender).

attributes.body: を問わず follows a noun (often a category) to show disregard for distinctions, as in 年齢を問わず (Regardless of age). にせよ・にしろ also implies that something holds true under different conditions, but it typically introduces a possibility that is then contrasted or disputed, as in 行くにせよ行かないにせよ (Whether you go or not…). を問わず highlights inclusiveness, while にせよ・にしろ highlights hypothetical contrasts.

attributes.body: どうしても and を問わず share the meaning of 'no matter' or 'regardless of', but are used differently. どうしても appears at the beginning of a sentence to express persistence or inevitability. For example, どうしても勝ちたい ('I want to win no matter what'). を問わず usually follows nouns or question words and shows that something holds true regardless of conditions. For example, 年齢を問わず参加できます ('You can participate regardless of age').

second_relatable.title: を問わず
second_relatable.meaning: Regardless of, Whether or not, No matter, With or without

attributes.body: ～ても～なくても and を問わず both express 'regardless of', but ～ても～なくても contrasts doing something with not doing it, e.g. 雨が降っても降らなくても ('whether it rains or not'), while を問わず states that something holds true regardless of category or attribute, e.g. 年齢を問わず ('regardless of age').
